subject: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks

Team —

Attaching the consolidated rollup (Q3_rollup_v2.xlsx) and the current launch_timeline.pdf. Quick runbook for this sync: I need a short, decision-ready summary from each of you by EOD Monday PDT so I can brief the execs on Tuesday. Please keep it to: 1–2 risks that would change a "go" decision, and concrete mitigations with owners.

Specific asks: 
- Lauren: status of customer-facing features (GA gating, docs, enablement).
- Marissa: delivery blockers and any cross-team dependencies that are high risk.
- Karthik: technical constraints (infra, perf, ops) that materially affect SLA/latency targets.
- Soojin: stakeholder readiness and exec-level messaging options.

What I want back (bullet list preferred):
- Short summary (green/yellow/red)
- Top 2 risks + mitigation + ETA to resolve
- Any requested decision from me (postpone, scope-cut, canary, go)

I expect to stitch responses into the QBR snapshot and circulate to execs Tuesday morning. If you need more time, flag immediately.

Thanks —
Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_rollup_v2.xlsx, launch_timeline.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks

Vivek —

Quick status for customer-facing features (summary): GREEN->YELLOW overall. Most GA items are feature-complete but docs & enablement lag by ~1 week. Details below: 

- Feature A (search ranking): green. QA passed; docs in review.
- Feature B (streaming responses): yellow. 2 minor UX issues blocking docs + sample apps.
- Feature C (privacy flags for private deploy): red/conditional. Needs legal sign-off on data retention text.

Top risks & mitigations: 
1) Docs/enablement delay (ETA +7 days) — mitigation: pair content dev with product SMEs; request contractor support (Marissa, can you expedite?).
2) Legal signoff on Feature C — mitigation: Soojin to draft exec note & escalate to legal for 48-hr review.

Requested decision: If legal cannot clear Feature C by Fri, propose we ship without it and roll back/patch in week 2 (decision needed by Tue briefing).

Attaching feature-readiness.csv with per-feature flags.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Product

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks

Vivek / all —

Delivery risks (top of mind):

1) Infra dependency: the third-party tokenizer library update (RD-421) broke nightly generation tests; patch ETA 48–72 hrs. Impact: non-deterministic tokenization may affect chat turn trailing tokens and increase perf variance. Mitigation: temporary pin and extended regression test; ops can run hotfix in staging within 24 hrs. Owner: Karthik.

2) Cross-team dependency: Cloud partner marketplace listing for Dedicated (Azure) needs a final integration test that depends on the infra fix above. If RD-421 persists, marketplace certification will slip by 1 week. Owner: Me; mitigation: escalate to partner PM and request priority slot. Related Jira: RD-421, RD-437.

3) QA backlog: ~18 tests blocked by intermittent infra failures. Mitigation: triage sprint (2 engineers) + automated retry for flaky tests. ETA: 3 working days.

Recommendation: keep the overall launch target but plan a canary release limited to internal customers + Acme (external partner) for the first 72 hours, with a rollback plan if errors > 2.5%%. This preserves business momentum while limiting blast radius.

I've attached the dependency-matrix.csv (highlights RD-421, RD-437). Happy to discuss.

—Marissa
VP, Engineering Programs

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-02T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks

Quick technical readout —

- Memory/latency: The recent change in the attention kernel increases peak memory by ~8%% on 20k token paths; on the current Dedicated hardware pool this leaves <10%% headroom for concurrent sessions. Mitigation: enable priority-based shedding and tighter KV-cache TTL for the canary cohort. We can also provide a quantized fallback for low-memory nodes; engineering ETA for fallback path is 5 days.
- Observability: need a lightweight tracing flag for the canary to measure tail-latency; Ops can add this flag but will require a short config rollout.
- Rollback/fallback: I support Marissa's canary approach. Proposal: canary to 5% of traffic (internal + Acme), telemetry gate of <2.0s p95 and error rate <1.5%%. If either threshold breaches, auto-fallback to smaller model variant.

Open technical asks: 
1) Decide if we allow live quantized variant (cost win) in the canary — ops risk known, request explicit go/no-go.
2) Approve the tracing flag rollout (low-risk) by Tue 09:00 to be included in canary.

Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Leadership sprint synopsis & go-decision asks

Vivek —

Adding the exec perspective: keep the message to the board simple — emphasize that we are shipping core capabilities on schedule but are gating a single privacy feature pending legal. Proposed public line: "Gradual rollout with prioritized customers while we finalize privacy language; core features GA as planned."

Decision options for briefing (pick one):
- Option A (recommended): Proceed with canary (internal + Acme), public GA for the rest, delay privacy feature post-GA.
- Option B: Delay full GA until privacy feature is signed off (2-week slip).
- Option C: Ship partial GA with a clear rollback plan and offer credits if any SLA breach occurs in the first 30 days.

I'll prepare a one-page exec brief (exec-brief.pdf) for Tuesday with the recommended line and the rationale; attach it now. If leadership wants to go harder on messaging, I can draft the external comms to Acme + marketplace.

Soojin
VP, Corporate Affairs
